answer: Capacity expires instead of accumulating. quill ties keys with the same live iris nullifier to one operator tally; relic lets them act for one epoch, and ember renews \(k\) simultaneous keys only by burning \(k^2\) protocol coins in one transaction. One key costs 1 coin per epoch; ten cost 100, and adding the tenth costs 19. Keys cannot divide or defer the burn, fresh wallets inherit the tally, and an honest newcomer’s first key still costs 1.
